recap.back_html: Data governance at the hub, ten knowledge areas around it. DMBOK2, revised in 2024.
The exercise of authority, control and shared decision-making (planning, monitoring and enforcement) over the management of data assets.
Reference: lists of codes. Master: the agreed record of a core entity. Metadata: data about data.
Name the knowledge area, then its owner, then the fix.
recap.front_html: First move on any data problem

lessons.takeaway_html: Name the knowledge area before you name the fix. Governance at the hub assigns an owner to each area, so problems reach the person who can solve them.
lessons.title: The DAMA wheel, eleven knowledge areas around governance

recap.back_html: 0 none, 1 initial, 2 repeatable, 3 defined, 4 managed, 5 optimised. Agree and version the names with stakeholders.
Knowledge areas by talent domain: workforce, recruitment, learning, performance, mobility, skills.
Its weakest area and score. A mean hides gaps.
A whole level with cited evidence: a document, a metric or a log.

lessons.takeaway_html: Score a grid of knowledge areas by talent domain, in whole levels, with evidence for each score, and report the weakest area per domain.
lessons.title: A maturity baseline you can defend

recap.back_html: Governance decides and oversees. Management does the work.
Definitions, access to sensitive fields, quality thresholds, and new uses of data.
Policy: what and why. Standard: measurable. Procedure: how. Each changes at its own pace.
Data steward, data owner, governance council. Log every decision with its reason.

lessons.takeaway_html: Separate deciding from doing. Name a decider for each kind of decision, write rules as policy, standard and procedure, and log each decision with its reason.
lessons.title: Governance at the hub, decision rights, policies and escalation

recap.back_html: Deterministic: exact keys, easy to explain, misses typos. Probabilistic: similarity score, catches more, makes false matches.
Merge above a high score, keep apart below a low one, and send the middle band to a data steward.
Source priority, most recent, most complete. A blank never overwrites a value.
Later deliveries find their person by source ID, and a false merge can be undone.

lessons.takeaway_html: Match in bands, with only deterministic keys merging automatically. Choose each field's value by a written rule, never let a blank win, and keep the cross-reference.
lessons.title: People master data, match rules and survivorship

summary: The eleven knowledge areas, governance at the hub, and an evidence-based maturity baseline across talent domains.
